description: Records a hard-cost Clio expense as the signed-in Clio user, matter attorney, firm default, or sole Clio user. Does not bill anyone. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

amount.description: Dollars, e.g. 175 for a $175 filing fee.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the cost was incurred. Defaults to today (UTC).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

non_billable.description: True keeps it off the client bill. Defaults to false.

note.description: Line item text the client sees on the bill.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

user_email.description: Clio user the expense is recorded under. Defaults to your Clio user; required if you have none.

name: create_matter_expense
title: Record matter expense
